claim: All seven 3-9B instruct models were classified Invalid on numeric verbal confidence, mean ceiling rate 91.7%, in 8,384 deterministic trials on 524 TriviaQA items.
quoted_support: All seven instruct models were classified Invalid on numeric confidence (H2 confirmed, 7/7 vs. predicted ≥ 4/7), with a mean ceiling rate of 91.7%
candidate_component_bearing: F (psychometric validity screening of verbal confidence as instrument) and L2 (verbal vs logprob; no probes). Not code; TriviaQA. Core claim on code with execution labels: no.
